findings.label: Selection-to-begin race remains
findings.issue: Two same-source supplies that both pass selection before either Run begins still share a chat, and the later begin() fences the earlier Run; the guard and the fence run in different transactions with search_handle() in between.
findings.action: Record this residual window in the evidence limitations; closing it needs a liveness check inside begin()'s write, outside Task A.

findings.label: Older-chat fallback untested
findings.issue: The regression covers only fallback to a new chat, not fallback to an older non-busy chat that received the source.
findings.action: Optionally add a case where an older eligible chat is chosen over a newer busy one.

findings.label: Empty chat per attempt when derived/ is unusable
findings.issue: Fail-closed liveness skips a chat with a Working Run when derived/ cannot be resolved; a new chat is created and begin() then refuses on the same derived/ check, leaving an empty chat each attempt.
findings.action: Return the storage error before creating a chat in that case, or note it beside the existing refused-start limitation.
